method: Read-only source diff and supplied Linux guard receipt inspection; no tests, product services, Rust, or commits executed by reviewer.

guard_receipt.source_identity_limit: Local helper hashes match stable summary; the raw selected unittest output does not itself print VM source hashes. Runtime preflight must independently bind the service helper identity.

accepted_checks: Fresh delete root is a fixed sibling of both earlier roots, not a path within either.
Delete TCP ports are disjoint from earlier read/write ports on each role; original read/write values remain unchanged.
Role-specific start_bind_ports performs only selected role lookup; no eagerly evaluated non-role dictionary expressions remain.
AFS Meta listen/endpoints and Node advertise/listen endpoints consistently use the selected fixture plan.
Moose master listen ports, chunk master endpoint and chunk listen port, client mount argv and mount source validation consistently use the selected fixture plan.
Readiness listener owner PID matching uses selected roles and selected ports.
Historical read prepare/preflight remains refused; new delete is an explicitly named mutable fixture.
Guest role/hostname, root boundary, symlink checks, ELF SHA, TLS checks, capacity, fresh configuration backup and exclusive lifecycle identities remain intact.
Supervisor/child source hash, boot ID, config SHA, role/root/fixture and process incarnation checks are unchanged.
Normal mount stop still requires the original mount incarnation, admitted fusermount3, actual supervisor wait exit0 and mount disappearance; no TERM fallback/lazy unmount/KILL introduced.
Seven affected guards have supplied Linux raw OK/exit0; the remaining unchanged guards were not repeated.
limits: This review approves only helper code/configuration delta; it is not proof of live authenticated topology, workload content correctness, deletion visibility or performance.
No complete suite claim and no G1 reopening.
Actual runtime admission and final normal cleanup remain the execution owner responsibility.
Existing launch receipts bind helper SHA: do not replace an active fixture helper file with this revision; stage it only in the fresh delete fixture.
